lines.text: This so-called Ark is nothing but a vessel, and sooner or later, it will sink.
The savagery of these outlaws is no worse than your own prejudice.
Nikkes and humans are destined to kill each other.
Your ability is amazing, in every aspect.

You want to be my friend?
You're not afraid of running afoul of the law, are you?

I hope this place doesn't chew you up and spit you out like the others.
I usually don't care about this kind of stuff, but... it's different with you.
This place is dead. I've got to liven it up a bit, make a splash!
There's nothing wrong with flights of fancy, but it's best to keep your feet on the ground and your head out of the clouds.
The Bar is the local watering hole for those freaks, so it has that going for it.
Viper, Jackal. I'm going out. Don't ask why. If you're curious, keep an eye on the news tomorrow.
One day in the Outer Rim will silence even the harshest critics of the Outpost.
So long as humans exist, so will their irrational ways. Complete extermination is the only solution.
What? Am I getting lighter?
This is nice.
Like shooting fish in a barrel.
Can this be exchanged for weapons?
Thanks.
... Why do you keep giving me gifts?
You are rather exceptional for a human. It's a shame that I must kill you.

If you were one of us, I'd be more than happy to show you some affection.
Don't get it twisted, I'm talking about like what Jackal and I have.

And what is it you expect in return for this... 
A big wet kiss?
So if I don't play ball, you paint the walls with my insides? I see how it is.
I'm listening.
Can you keep up?
Encounter.
Initiate contact?
Bystanders are not welcome.
I'm just cannon fodder to you, aren't I?
... I grow tired of this.
Reloading.
Out of ammo... Just when things were getting good...
Go!
Violence is always the answer.
Ah, the thrill of the hunt!
You're no fun.
If you want to fight a losing battle, then be my guest.
Easy-peasy.
Uh.
Urgh!
Ha...
Sorry, but I've got to go.
Happy, you government lap dog?
